# deps: tools: up yq to v4.25.2

Pin `yq` at v4.25.2 in the Go toolset, following [[DOT-283]] (v4.24.5). `yq` is mikefarah's Go YAML/JSON processor with `jq`-like syntax; the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v4.25.2 tag](https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/tag/v4.25.2).
